home.intro: From Bangoulap, in the highlands of West Cameroon, the Jean-Félicien Gacha Foundation nurtures vocations, develops talent and shares knowledge.
home.missionTitle: Sharing skills and knowledge, to grow as people
home.missionText: A non-governmental organisation, the Foundation works in five areas: education and training, culture and crafts, health and social action, environment and farming, and community tourism.
home.presidentQuote: We will be delighted to welcome you to the Jean-Félicien Gacha Foundation, to discover and share all of our activities.
home.statRooms: rooms and suites at Villa Boutanga
home.statResidents: artists and writers hosted in residence
home.statAltitude: above sea level, in the Grassfields
home.actionsIntro: From the village school to the artist residency, the Foundation passes on Cameroon’s knowledge and know-how.
home.villaTitle: Villa Boutanga, in the heart of the hills
home.villaText: Twenty-six rooms and suites, Le Jacaranda restaurant and guided trips across West Cameroon: staying at the Villa supports the Foundation.
home.heritageTitle: Ndop, the cloth of royal courts
home.heritageText: The Ly and Frédéric Dumas collection, the beadwork workshops and the collection of traditional songs keep Grassfields heritage alive, from Bangoulap to São Paulo.
home.supportTitle: Every gift helps a talent grow
home.supportText: A donation, a membership, a stay or a few weeks of volunteering: there are many ways to support education, culture and health in Bangoulap.
home.heroAlt: The Foundation’s heritage huts, draped with Ndop cloth
home.partnersIntro: Institutions, museums, universities and associations working alongside the Foundation.

actions.title: Our work
actions.intro: Education, training, culture, health, environment, community tourism: the Foundation works on every front for the communities of West Cameroon.

pages.donateQuestions: A question about donating or volunteering?
pages.volunteerText: Teachers, craftspeople, carers, students or retirees: share your skills for a few weeks in Bangoulap. Our donations and volunteering team will help you plan your stay.
pages.publicationsText: Books published by the Foundation and its president, available at the shop or on request.
pages.contactText: The Foundation is in Bangoulap, next to Bangangté, in the Ndé division of West Cameroon.
pages.hubStayText: Sleep at Villa Boutanga, dine at Le Jacaranda, visit the collection and take home a piece from the workshops.
pages.hubSupportText: Donation, membership, partnership or volunteering: join the people who keep the Foundation alive.
pages.hubResourcesText: Press, films, podcasts, activity reports and the Foundation’s publications.
pages.legalPublisherText: This website is published by the NGO Fondation Jean-Félicien Gacha, Bangoulap (West Cameroon).
pages.legalHostingText: Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA.
pages.legalDataText: Information sent by email or through the forms is only used to answer your request. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time by writing to contact@fondationgacha.org. The site uses no advertising cookies.
pages.legalCreditsText: Photographs: Fondation Jean-Félicien Gacha and their authors. Patterns inspired by Ndop, the cloth of the Grassfields.
pages.roomsIntro: Nightly rates from 1 January 2024. Breakfast is served at Le Jacaranda restaurant.
pages.restaurantIntro: Villa Boutanga’s restaurant welcomes you inside or on the terrace, facing the hills of Bangoulap.
